{{Quote|One does not breathe the air here, one drinks it.|[[Fliry Vorru]] |<ref name="X:Bacta" />}}
'''Thyferra''' was a hot, humid [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Polith system]] on the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]], on which most of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] was produced. It was also a major political power as bacta production was an essential commodity.

==Characteristics==
Thyferra, in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Polith system]] at [[Galactic coordinates/Legends|galactic coordinates]] L-14,<ref name="TEA" /> was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Vratix/Legends|Vratix]] people.<ref name="X:Bacta" /> Approximately half of the planet's surface was covered by the [[Alazhi/Legends|alazhi]] [[Bacteria/Legends|bacteria]], while most of the other half was covered by [[Jungle/Legends|rainforest]].<ref name="Strongholds" />

==History==
The Vratix had already colonized many celestial bodies in the Polith system when they were in first contact with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] around [[4100 BBY]].

[[File:Vratix_with_bacta_SWJ3.png|thumb|left|200px|A Vratix with containers of bacta.]]

Since the Vratix had discovered how to create bacta from alazhi and [[Kavam/Legends|kavam]], the planet became an important Republic world, drawing profit-hungry [[Human/Legends|human]] colonists. The Vratix shared the secret of bacta production with their Human neighbors, who eventually gained control of the bacta industry and hired many of the natives as workers in their bacta plants.

Between [[3959 BBY]] to [[3956 BBY]], during the [[Jedi Civil War]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] had become part of [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire]].<ref name="TEA" /> Throughout the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the planet enjoyed a reputation of owning miraculous botanical cures on which smart [[Botanist/Legends|botanists]] have cashed in quite a lot for decades.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Scavenging|Jungle Medicine}}</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederate Third Fleet|Third Fleet]] of the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] was based at Thyferra. In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the fleet joined the [[Confederate First Fleet|First Fleet]] for an [[Battle of Duro (Clone Wars)|attack]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet [[Duro/Legends|Duro]].<ref name="CIS Shadowfeed" />

Eventually, Thyferra was almost completely controlled by two Human-run corporations: [[Zaltin Corporation|Zaltin]] and [[Xucphra Corporation|Xucphra]]. These two corporations were chosen by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to supply the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] bacta, thus eliminating any real competition in the bacta market.

[[File:Rsthyferra.jpg|left|thumb|Rogue Squadron's Thyferra attack.]]
Prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] led an [[Assault on Thyferra|assault]] to root out a traitor. At the end, he [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force-choked]] an [[Unidentified Imperial commander (Thyferra)|Imperial commander]].<ref name="EAW">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''</ref>

The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] bacta supply on the planet was a target set by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kohl Seerdon]]. Around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], after [[Raid on Sullust|setting]] a diversion on [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], he [[Attack on Thyferra|invaded the planet]], sending [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-STs]] and [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE interceptors]] to prevent Alliance bacta from reaching the group. However, the plot was thwarted by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], and Seerdon was killed<ref name="RS I" /> after engaging [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in a dogfight.

Thyferra was [[Battle of Thyferra (5 ABY)|liberated]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" /> However, the New Republic didn't settle on the planet which stayed officially neutral in the war. Thyferra was in fact in trouble due to significant tensions between Humans and Vratix and between the [[Xucphra Corporation|Xucphra]] and [[Zaltin Corporation]].<ref name="X-Wing">[[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'' novel series]]</ref>

In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], [[Ysanne Isard]] backed a coup that saw a pro-Imperial faction taking over Thyferra. The faction later elected her head of state, allowing her to remain in lawful power, eliminate the Zaltin, control the bacta industry, and start a small but important conflict known as the [[Bacta War]]. During the [[Battle of Thyferra]], Rogue Squadron and its allies, operating at the time independent from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]—which for political reasons could not directly interfere—liberated Thyferra from the Empire and imperial loyalists using guerrilla tactics, pluck, and native allies.<ref name="X:Bacta" />

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] attempted to poison the planet's bacta supplies. The scheme did not come to fruition.

Thyferra later [[Coup on Thyferra|joined]] the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] in the [[Swarm War]], the [[New Jedi Order]] being unable to defend it from a coup orchestrated by the Killiks. Following the end of the war, Thyferra reverted to Alliance control.

[[File:Thyferra2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|thumb|Thyferra and its moons.]]

==Behind the scenes==
{{Expandsect}}
The planet Thyferra first appeared in the article "[[The Business of Bacta]]," and then in the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''X-Wing'' novel series]]. A battle takes place on the planet in the Imperial campaign of the [[2006]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''.
